messages:
Alex Chen: RFC: rolling internal API surface from REST -> gRPC. Starting a gradual rollout playbook draft — want ops + console input. Key concerns: routing policy changes, quota propagation, telemetry/dashboard signals, and UX for canary sizes. Thoughts?
Maria Gomez: +1. Two quick asks: we need a compatibility gateway that can accept JSON->gRPC for browsers/old clients. Also quota headers MUST be preserved (X-Customer-Id, X-Quota-Key).
Raj Patel: Agreed. I'm leaning sidecar for tenant-local routing, gateway for tenant-agnostic fallbacks. Canary plan: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 50% with automated gating/rollback.
Oliver King: Which SLOs will gate promotion? p95 latency, error rate, and model-invocation retry rate. Also monitor token-cost/regression.
Frank Li: Add a proto-schema evolution CI check (backwards/forwards compat). We'll need a console toggle so product can promote canaries manually.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: 1741122380. Please ensure `canary-metricset` tag in traces and `proto-ci` hook enabled.
Alex Chen: Telemetry proposal: per-route dashboard with p50/p95, qps, errors, cold-start percentiles, and a quota mismatch metric `quota_propagation_failures`. Also surface trace examples when schema errors occur.
Maria Gomez: For quota semantics: pass both token and unit counts. If gateway can't confirm quota, fallback to soft-limit policy with 503 + header `X-Quota-Partial` so clients can backoff gracefully.
Raj Patel: Define gating rules more precisely: no >2% absolute increase in p95, error rate increase <0.1% absolute, and zero `schema_unmarshal_error` logs in sampled traces for 10m.
Oliver King: Console UX asks: show current cohort size, health state (green/yellow/red), one-click rollback, and link to example traces and request/response diffs.
Frank Li: On JSON->gRPC bridging: suggest using envoy transcoding for simple endpoints, but for richer contracts we should run a thin gateway which can replay traffic to both endpoints for verification. Danger: replay can double-charge quotas.
Frank Li: Example headers we require on incoming requests to avoid double-charge:
```
X-Customer-Id: <id>
X-Quota-Key: projects/123
X-Idempotency-Key: <uuid>
```
Alex Chen: Replay idea + sampling is nice. Add requirement: replayed requests must carry `X-Replay-Exempt: true` so quota-meter can ignore them.
Maria Gomez: Yep, use `X-Idempotency-Key` + `X-Replay-Exempt`. Also add a metric `replay_ignored_count` to make sure replay-exempt isn't being abused.
Raj Patel: Ops: schema registry should be central (git repo + CI). deploy-bot should block promotion if proto-ci fails or compatibility checks fail.
deploy-bot: proto-ci hook added to the repo. Failing builds will block canary promotion.
Oliver King: :thumbsup: Next actions for the playbook PR: steps for canary promotion, exact gating thresholds, console mockups (cohort + health + traces), and a tiny POC of JSON->gRPC shim with replay mode.
Alex Chen: I'll open the playbook PR today and link this thread. Tagging @Maria @Raj @Frank for reviewers. Thanks everyone :rocket:
